name: tencent-docs
description: Tencent Docs (腾讯文档, doc.qq.com) connector via the official OpenAPI. Provides the 'tencent-docs' app connection for plugins that list, search, read, create, edit, and export online documents / spreadsheets / smartsheets / forms hosted on doc.qq.com.

授权范围 scope (空格分隔, 例如: doc:read doc:write drive:read drive:write)

interface.shortDescription: Tencent Docs (腾讯文档, doc.qq.com) connector via the official OpenAPI. Provides the 'tencent-docs' app connection for plugins that read, edit, or export online documents, spreadsheets, and slides hosted on doc.qq.com.
interface.longDescription: Tencent Docs (腾讯文档) connector via the official OpenAPI documented at https://docs.qq.com/open/document/app/. Operations are dispatched through the connector registered as 'tencent-docs' in the duya AppConnectorRegistry. All API calls go through the connector — this plugin ships the connector declaration and skill documentation only; you must provide your own Tencent Docs Open Platform credentials (ClientId + ClientSecret + redirect_uri) at install time and complete the OAuth2 authorization code grant once. The OpenAPI covers five product areas: 文件管理 / 在线表格 / 在线智能表 / 在线文档 / 在线收集表.
